findings.text: The worst case node reserve for a single tree modification scales with maximum depth as twice depth minus one.

Identifier keys use all but the sign position of a host integer for indexing, derive maximum depth by rounding that width up over the per level key slice, and size their reserve with the same twice depth minus one relationship.
The radix iteration retry marker shares identity with the extended array retry marker.
Each processor owns a private spare node reserve described by a head link, a population count and a dedicated local serializing lock.
The power management fault injection descriptor advertises preparation coverage for hibernation suspend and restore followed by a terminator, plus an embedded notifier registration block.

Power management fault injection setup publishes a dedicated control directory and subscribes its notifier, undoing the directory on subscribe failure, while teardown unsubscribes then removes the directory.

Tree subsystem bringup validates tag and flag layout assumptions at build time, creates a dedicated node cache with a zeroing constructor and list initialization, and installs a dead processor hook that drains stranded reserves; cache creation failure is treated as fatal.

Callers can reserve worst case insertion storage ahead of atomic tree updates, choosing an unconditional reservation that expects blocking capable allocation or a conditional form that only reserves when blocking is permitted.
The tree offers insertion with conflict detection, slot replacement, deletion by key and deletion through an active iterator.
The tree offers direct slot lookup, per entry tag manipulation returning the underlying entry, chunked iteration with optional tag filtering and bounded bulk collection of entries or slots.

Supporting services expose identifier reserve acquisition and whole identifier tree teardown, per state pseudorandom byte filling with full per processor reseeding, and a shared rate limiting decision routine.
Tree root flags jointly encode allocation context and tag presence, with allocation context limited to non zone reclaim bits and tag presence obtained by shifting toward the tag field.

Reserve refill never charges allocations to a memory cgroup because refills may migrate across groups, links spares through their parent field, and reports memory exhaustion when backing allocation fails.

Insertion path establishment grows tree height to cover the requested key using the root allocation context, materializes absent interior levels while maintaining occupancy counts, halts at data entries without descending further, and distinguishes growth failures from allocation failures.

Successful placement into an empty slot publishes the new entry, accounts occupancy and encoded value population, rejects internal markers as data values, rejects overwrites as existence conflicts, and expects both fresh leaf slots and fresh root direct entries to carry no tags.

Tag setting propagates presence from leaf toward root while tag clearing propagates absence upward only when the addressed entry exists, with clearing tolerating out of range keys as absent and setting treating them as a programming error.

Bounded bulk scans skip empty positions and transparently restart past transient internal markers up to the requested limit, identifier teardown releases all interior storage and leaves an empty marked free root, and subtree release requires interior auxiliary lists to be empty.

Byte filling is a pure function of successive generator draws split across whole words and a final partial word, reseeding derives every processor substate from fresh entropy clamped to distinct minima, and reseeded states are advanced through a fixed warmup count before use.

Reserve access serializes on the per processor lock with allocation performed outside the critical section; unconditional and conditional tree preloads return with the lock held on success, while the underlying refill reports failure without holding it.
Identifier preload preserves the invariant that the caller holds the reserve lock on return even when backing allocation fails.

Rate limit state updates prefer an interrupt safe try acquisition and fall back to a lockless atomic allowance check under contention, accepting rare false allowance near interval boundaries rather than blocking.

Iteration state couples a current key, a resume key, accumulated tag bits and a node anchor; resume advances by one and clears filtering, chunk location handles empty and singleton trees specially, contiguous scans abort on holes while filtered or plain scans skip toward the next populated or tagged position, and key wraparound terminates the walk.

Limiting decisions follow an initialized flag plus window start plus remaining allowance plus suppressed miss count; first use initializes the window, expiry resets allowance and optionally reports suppressed callbacks, a zero interval disables limiting and a non positive burst with a positive interval denies unconditionally, with allowance granted as a positive decision and exhaustion recorded as a miss.

Insertion repair maintains a red subject node invariant, finishes on absent or black parentage with a black root, recolors and ascends past red sibling subtrees, converts inner grandchildren by a parent rotation into the outer configuration, then resolves outer grandchildren by a grandparent rotation with recoloring, invoking augmentation on each structural rotation and mirroring the logic on both sides.

Node color shares storage with the parent link, with blackening expressed as an increment of the combined field and red parentage recovered by masking that field, while rotation preserves the moved color field and rewires the affected child link in the grandparent or root.

Supplying an internal marker as inserted data, inserting where a slot is already populated, tagging beyond the current maximum key, freeing a subtree whose auxiliary lists remain linked, and requesting bulk collection with a zero limit are treated respectively as a fatal programming error, an existence conflict, a fatal error or absent result depending on direction, a one time warning, and an immediate empty result.

Reserving tree storage with a non blocking allocation mask, configuring a negative rate limit interval or burst, failing to register dead processor cleanup, and observing iterator retry markers all signal special handling through warnings retry or degraded allowance rather than silent success.
